svg.title: Credit memo and remaining customer credit
svg.desc: Credit memo and remaining customer credit. The solid arrow identifies the original-invoice key. Dashed arrows describe accounting allocation and conditional later refund chronology, not database joins. Keep the record grains separate. Foreign-key paths, analytical matches, and business context answer different questions; read the numbered evidence table before joining.
